description: This line plot illustrates the Macro-F1 Score (%) as a function of the Number of tokens, comparing two approaches: “MATTER (ours)” and “w/o material information”. The x-axis, labeled “Number of tokens”, ranges from approximately 0.6 to 1.4 and uses a linear scale, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%)”, ranges from 48% to 58% and also uses a linear scale, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 2%. The “MATTER (ours)” approach is represented by a solid pink line with circular markers, which starts at approximately 55%, rises to a peak of 58% at 1.0 token, then declines to about 51% at 1.4 tokens. The “w/o material information” approach is represented by a solid purple line with circular markers, which starts at approximately 52%, rises slightly to about 54% at 0.8 tokens, remains relatively stable near 52% until 1.4 tokens, then drops sharply to 48% at 1.4 tokens. Both lines are accompanied by shaded regions indicating variability or confidence intervals.
